description: One heads-up PLO4 hand, as played, against the flop blueprint in one call: every flop decision mapped onto the blueprint tree (sizes to the nearest blueprint size), and for each of the hero's decisions the best action, every action's EV for the exact hand, the loss of the action played (bb and % of pot), whether it counts as a mistake, the hand's percentile in its range and the opponent's response to each action. Pass `hand` exactly as pokerstudy.ai's get_hand returns it in `raw.hand` (players with startingStack and cards; actions with street, actionType and amount, raises as "raise to") and `hero` (raw.hero). The stack is matched to the nearest blueprint depth. When this exact turn spot has been solved, `turnDecisions` gives the same answers for every turn decision; otherwise pass solve_turn: true to queue a GPU solve of it (about 2 to 4 minutes) and call again. Rivers work the same way: when the turn is solved and the hand reached the river, `riverDecisions` gives every river decision from an exact river solve that starts from the turn solve's own river ranges, and solve_turn: true queues that solve when it is missing.

hand.description: Parsed hand: { bigBlind, players: [{ playerName, startingStack, cards }], actions: [{ playerName, actionType, amount, street }], communityCards }.

hero.description: Hero's player name in the hand.

mistake_bb.description: Loss in bb above which a decision counts as a mistake (default 0.1).

solve_turn.description: When the hand's turn (or, once the turn is solved, river) spot is not solved yet, queue a solve for it (about 2 to 4 minutes; call again for the decisions).

name: analyze_hu_plo_hand

outputSchema.description: One heads-up PLO4 hand against the flop blueprint: every flop decision, and for the hero's the best action, EVs, loss and mistake flag.

items.description: One flop decision: line, actor, played, mappedTo, potBb, rangeStrategy; for the hero also handStrategy, handEvBb, best, evLossBb, evLossPctPot, mistake, rangePercentile, opponentResponses (or reaches: false).

effectiveStackBb.description: Effective stack in the hand, in big blinds.

error.description: Present instead of a payload when the request named something that does not exist. No figure is estimated in its place.

handId.description: Hand id when the input had one.

items.description: A note on how the hand was mapped.

preflop.description: Preflop line in blueprint names, e.g. "SB_Open_BB_Call".

river.description: When the turn is solved and the hand saw a river: the river spot (turnSpot, turnLine, card, potBb, behindBb, riverBets), spotId, whether it is solved, and `solve` when a solve was queued.

riverDecisions.description: River decisions in order, when the river spot is solved.

items.description: One river decision from the exact river solve, in the same shape as a flop decision.

stack.description: Blueprint depth used (nearest to the effective stack).

turn.description: When the hand saw a turn: the spot (stack, preflop, flopLine, board, potBb, behindBb, turn sizes), spotId, whether it is solved, and `solve` when a solve was queued.

turnDecisions.description: Turn decisions in order, when the spot is solved.

items.description: One turn decision from the solve of this spot, in the same shape as a flop decision.

title: Analyze a heads-up PLO4 hand
